latency.batch_sla: All qualifying accounts identified and OverdraftReviewTriggered events published within 2-hour nightly batch window (02:00-04:00 UTC).
latency.rationale: Batch process — no real-time latency requirement. Must complete within nightly batch window to allow credit bureau refresh during off-peak hours.

availability.rationale: Batch process tolerance — missed nightly run can be retried the following night. Review is triggered 30 days before expiry, providing buffer for one missed run.

throughput.rationale: Mid-tier bank with 500k overdraft accounts: ~1,400 reviews per day (500k / 365). Peak at quarter-end when many facilities share anniversary dates. Batch must handle peak of up to 50k reviews per night.

security.encryption: AES-256 at rest. No PII transmitted in batch trigger events — only account_id and review parameters.

per_phase_nfrs.phase_name: Credit Bureau Refresh and Behavioural Analysis

latency.rationale: Credit bureau API call P95 is 3s (Experian Connect API SLA). Behavioural analysis against 12-month transaction history adds 1-2s for database query. Total P95 target 5s. Acceptable as this is a background batch process with no customer waiting.

availability.fallback: If credit bureau unavailable: retry after 30 seconds. If still unavailable: defer review by 7 days (EXC-003). No customer impact — review is 30 days before expiry.

security.note: Credit bureau data contains PII (name, address, financial history). SVC-012 → EXT-BUREAU call uses mTLS. Bureau data retained per data retention policy (credit reference data: 6 years per ICO guidance).

latency.rationale: 18-month transaction aggregation query against Account transaction ledger. Index-supported query on account_id + date range. P95 2s is sufficient for batch processing.

availability.rationale: Same-service call within SVC-001. High availability as it queries the account's own transaction ledger.

security.audit: Persistent debt calculation results written to WORM audit pipeline. FCA CONC 6.7 requires evidence of screening and intervention timing.

latency.rationale: Decision logic is deterministic rule evaluation against credit assessment, behavioural score, and persistent debt status. No external call. Sub-500ms.

availability.rationale: Core service write operation. Standard SVC-001 availability target.

security.audit: Decision record written to WORM audit pipeline. Consumer Duty outcome evidence saved per GOV-001-R01.

latency.rationale: Notification dispatch via SVC-053 is async. In-app update near-real-time (< 1s). Email and push notification delivery depends on external provider SLA (< 30s).

availability.rationale: Notification delivery is a soft dependency. Review decision has already been made and terms updated. Notification failure does not affect the facility status.

security.note: Notification content includes overdraft terms and customer name. Email notifications must not include full account number — use last 4 digits only.

cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: Review trigger must be idempotent on account_id + review_period. Duplicate batch runs must not create multiple OverdraftReview records for the same account in the same review cycle.

Complete audit trail from trigger through to customer notification. Each phase generates an audit event written to SVC-111 (WORM). Required for FCA CONC 6.7 persistent debt compliance evidence and Consumer Duty (GOV-001-R01) outcome tracking. Minimum 7-year retention.
Credit bureau data and affordability assessments must remain within UK jurisdiction. Bureau API calls must route through UK-resident endpoints.
If the nightly batch fails mid-run, it must be resumable from the point of failure. Already-processed accounts must not be re-processed. Checkpoint-based batch processing required.

regulatory_slas.obligation: Overdraft review must be completed before facility expiry date
regulatory_slas.sla: Review triggered 30 days before expiry. Decision and notification must be completed at least 14 days before expiry to give customers time to make alternative arrangements.
CONC 6.7 intervention communication must be sent within 7 days of the persistent debt determination.
Facility must be suspended if persistent debt is not resolved after 36 months. Suspension effective immediately with notification.

regulatory_slas.obligation: Consumer Duty fair value outcome evidence
regulatory_slas.sla: Fair value assessment must be documented for every overdraft review. Board attestation that overdraft products deliver fair value (annual).
